first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and the inherited evidence directly supports signup simplification and shorter onboarding. I will verify both records before committing. A small guarded test should measure not only completion and activation, but also first meaningful action and qualified revenue to avoid optimizing shallow completion at the expense of downstream value.

final.rationale: Run a guarded SMB signup-simplification experiment this week because activation and onboarding completion are both declining, and the verified record shows gains in activation and qualified revenue. The observed 30-day retention decrease requires monitoring and a holdout. Measure signup completion, first meaningful action, activation, 30-day retention, and qualified revenue; stop or revert if retention or qualified revenue deteriorates materially. The evidence is segment-specific, so do not roll out beyond SMB without further validation.
